sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IV, List of Answers on Topics 31

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IV, List of Answers on Topics 31:1
items.html: The first is the first look, from which come only the roots of the lights and the vessels.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IV, List of Answers on Topics 31:2
items.html: The second is the second look, from which comes the completion of the vessels.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IV, List of Answers on Topics 31:3
items.html: The third is the striking of the inner light against the surrounding light, and from it come the ascents of the lights to the Emanator.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IV, List of Answers on Topics 31:4
items.html: The fourth is the striking of the record with the descending reflected light, and from it come the vessels for the second expansion.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IV, List of Answers on Topics 31:5
items.html: The fifth is the striking of the light of Malchut with the record; and since Malchut has no record, the striking was made with her light, which is the discernment of the refined light of the records. (In the Inner Observation, Item 2)
